## Summary
- Restore the terminal foreground process-group after running shell PATH probes in `ShellCommandLocator.runShellCommand`.
- Prevents `watch` sessions from losing TTY foreground ownership and hanging on interactive interrupt handling (`Ctrl+C`) after CLI commands.

## Validation
- `swift build --product CodexBarCLI -c debug`
